# SNN_Robustness_Noise

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The inherent resilience of spiking neural networks to input noise and signal variability, particularly relevant for noisy biological signals like sEMG. Ensures reliable fatigue detection in real-world conditions, reducing the need for extensive signal preprocessing in neuromorphic systems.
